    # Type 'primer' in the textbox and wait for dropdown, then select the matching user

    await page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Select members to invite').fill('convexegg')
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)  # Wait for dropdown to appear
    await page.get_by_role('option', name='convexegg').click()  # Assuming 'convexegg' is the exact name in dropdown
    
    # Type 'abishek' in the textbox and wait for dropdown, then select the matching user
    await page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Select members to invite').fill('abishek')
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)  # Wait for dropdown to appear
    await page.get_by_role('option', name='abishek').click()  # Assuming 'abishek' is the exact name in dropdown
